scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n universe,bp,gamedev,vcut -c blue,green,yellow,cyan "pnpm dev" "pnpm dev:bp" "pnpm dev:gamedev" "pnpm dev:vcut"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n next,electron -c blue,magenta "pnpm dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 && pnpm --filter @veasnawt/desktop dev"
scripts.dev:vcut-desktop: concurrently -k -n next,electron -c blue,magenta "pnpm dev:vcut" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3002 && pnpm --filter @veasnawt/vcut-desktop dev"
